description: Turns the streams from up to six 8GT or 8CV Encoders into the stereo pair an ES-5 expander decodes

inputs.text: Carries the encoded stream from an 8GT Encoder or 8CV Encoder to the ES-5 expansion header of the same number; the voltage is truncated to a whole number and clamped to 0 and 255

outputs.text: The left channel of the encoded pair, built from the first three inputs; patch it to one channel of the audio pair driving the ES-5
The right channel of the encoded pair, built from the last three inputs; patch it to the other channel of that pair

notes: Each input corresponds to one expansion header on the physical ES-5, and the two outputs go to the stereo audio channel driving it, usually channels 7 and 8 of an ES-3 or ES-8.
Nothing reaches the hardware until an 8GT Encoder or 8CV Encoder is patched into an input.
